      <line x1="352" y1="76" x2="358" y2="82" stroke="#4E4B66" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    </g>
    <line x1="24" y1="101" x2="366" y2="101" stroke="#EEF1F4" stroke-width="1"/>

    <!-- Article context -->
    <g>
      <rect x="23" y="111" width="344" height="78" rx="6" fill="#000000" opacity=".05"/>
      <rect x="22" y="109" width="344" height="78" rx="6" fill="#F3F3F3"/>
      <rect x="34" y="121" width="65" height="54" rx="6" fill="#C4C4C4"/>
      <circle cx="83" cy="132" r="6" fill="#F4B740"/>
      <polygon points="39,168 57,146 68,158 77,150 94,168" fill="#7B61FF"/>
      <text x="113" y="130" font-size="11" font-weight="600" fill="#1877F2" letter-spacing=".12">THE DAILY BRIEF</text>
      <text x="113" y="149" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#050505" letter-spacing=".12">Cities rethink the future</text>
      <text x="113" y="168" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#4E4B66" letter-spacing=".12">of work and public spaces</text>
    </g>

    <!-- Composer -->
    <text x="24" y="214" font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#050505" letter-spacing=".12">Join the conversation</text>
    <g>
      <circle cx="43" cy="244" r="18" fill="#7B61FF"/>
      <text x="43" y="249" text-anchor="middle" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF" letter-spacing=".12">JD</text>
      <rect x="70" y="221" width="296" height="47" rx="6" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#4E4B66" stroke-width="1"/>
      <text x="84" y="250" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#A0A3BD" letter-spacing=".12">Share your thoughts...</text>
      <circle cx="345" cy="244" r="13" fill="#1877F2"/>
      <polyline points="339,244 346,244 343,240" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.7"/>
      <line x1="346" y1="244" x2="351" y2="244" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.7"/>

    <text x="24" y="307" font-size="16" font-weight="700" fill="#050505" letter-spacing=".12">Latest comments</text>
    <g>
      <rect x="294" y="292" width="72" height="27" rx="6" fill="#EEF1F4"/>
      <text x="306" y="310" font-size="11" font-weight="600" fill="#667080" letter-spacing=".12">Newest</text>

    <!-- Comment 1 -->
    <g>
      <circle cx="42" cy="347" r="18" fill="#1877F2"/>
      <text x="42" y="352" text-anchor="middle" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF" letter-spacing=".12">AM</text>
      <text x="70" y="338" font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#050505" letter-spacing=".12">Alex Morgan</text>
      <text x="70" y="355" font-size="11" font-weight="400" fill="#A0A3BD" letter-spacing=".12">12 min ago</text>
      <rect x="70" y="364" width="296" height="55" rx="6" fill="#F3F3F3"/>
      <text x="82" y="384" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#4E4B66" letter-spacing=".12">The shift to flexible work is changing</text>
      <text x="82" y="402" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#4E4B66" letter-spacing=".12">what people expect from their neighborhoods.</text>
      <circle cx="84" cy="435" r="10" fill="#EEF1F4"/>
      <text x="84" y="439" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10" font-weight="600" fill="#1877F2" letter-spacing=".12">♥</text>
      <text x="100" y="439" font-size="11" font-weight="600" fill="#667080" letter-spacing=".12">24 likes</text>
      <text x="170" y="439" font-size="11" font-weight="600" fill="#1877F2" letter-spacing=".12">Reply</text>
      <text x="334" y="439" font-size="18" font-weight="700" fill="#667080" letter-spacing=".12">···</text>
    </g>

    <!-- Nested reply 1 -->
    <g>
      <line x1="43" y1="458" x2="43" y2="530" stroke="#EEF1F4" stroke-width="2"/>
      <circle cx="68" cy="474" r="15" fill="#00BA88"/>
      <text x="68" y="479" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF" letter-spacing=".12">SL</text>
      <text x="94" y="470" font-size="13" font-weight="600" fill="#050505" letter-spacing=".12">Sofia Lee</text>
      <text x="94" y="486" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#A0A3BD" letter-spacing=".12">8 min ago</text>
      <rect x="94" y="494" width="272" height="48" rx="6" fill="#F3F3F3"/>
      <text x="106" y="514" font-size="11" font-weight="400" fill="#4E4B66" letter-spacing=".12">Exactly. Community spaces may matter</text>
      <text x="106" y="530" font-size="11" font-weight="400" fill="#4E4B66" letter-spacing=".12">more than ever now.</text>
      <text x="106" y="558" font-size="11" font-weight="600" fill="#667080" letter-spacing=".12">8 likes</text>
      <text x="161" y="558" font-size="11" font-weight="600" fill="#1877F2" letter-spacing=".12">Reply</text>
    </g>

    <!-- Comment 2 -->
    <g>
      <circle cx="42" cy="590" r="18" fill="#F4B740"/>
      <text x="42" y="595" text-anchor="middle" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF" letter-spacing=".12">DR</text>
      <text x="70" y="580" font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#050505" letter-spacing=".12">Daniel Reed</text>
      <text x="70" y="597" font-size="11" font-weight="400" fill="#A0A3BD" letter-spacing=".12">26 min ago</text>
      <rect x="70" y="606" width="296" height="55" rx="6" fill="#F3F3F3"/>
      <text x="82" y="626" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#4E4B66" letter-spacing=".12">Good reporting, but I wonder how smaller</text>
      <text x="82" y="644" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#4E4B66" letter-spacing=".12">towns will adapt to these changes.</text>
      <circle cx="84" cy="677" r="10" fill="#EEF1F4"/>
      <text x="84" y="681" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10" font-weight="600" fill="#1877F2" letter-spacing=".12">♥</text>
      <text x="100" y="681" font-size="11" font-weight="600" fill="#667080" letter-spacing=".12">11 likes</text>
      <text x="170" y="681" font-size="11" font-weight="600" fill="#1877F2" letter-spacing=".12">Reply</text>
      <text x="334" y="681" font-size="18" font-weight="700" fill="#667080" letter-spacing=".12">···</text>
    </g>

    <!-- Comment 3 partial but populated -->
    <g>
      <circle cx="42" cy="720" r="18" fill="#ED2E7E"/>
      <text x="42" y="725" text-anchor="middle" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF" letter-spacing=".12">NT</text>
      <text x="70" y="710" font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#050505" letter-spacing=".12">Nina Torres</text>
      <text x="70" y="727" font-size="11" font-weight="400" fill="#A0A3BD" letter-spacing=".12">41 min ago</text>

      <text x="82" y="761" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#4E4B66" letter-spacing=".12">I’m optimistic about the possibilities.</text>
      <text x="100" y="798" font-size="11" font-weight="600" fill="#667080" letter-spacing=".12">5 likes</text>
      <text x="170" y="798" font-size="11" font-weight="600" fill="#1877F2" letter-spacing=".12">Reply</text>
